# acecloud_key_pair (Resource)

Manages an Ace Cloud SSH key pair.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generate a new key pair (private key returned in state)
resource "acecloud_key_pair" "generated" {
  name = "deploy-key"
}

# Or import an existing public key
resource "acecloud_key_pair" "imported" {
  name       = "my-laptop"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the key pair. Allowed characters: letters, numbers, hyphens.

### Optional

- `public_key` (String) SSH public key. If not provided, a key pair will be generated and the private key returned on create.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) Fingerprint of the SSH public key.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the key pair.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Generated private key in OpenSSH PEM format. Returned only on create when `public_key` is not supplied. Empty when the caller provides their own `public_key`.
